mapper.select: select * from aoa_notice_list where title like '%${kw}%' order by ${sort}
select * from aoa_director where pinyin like '${pinyin}%' and director_id in (select director_id from aoa_director_users where catelog_name='${catalog}')
select u.* from aoa_user u left join aoa_dept d on u.dept_id=d.dept_id where u.real_name like '%${name}%' and d.dept_name='${dept}'
select * from aoa_file_list where file_shuffix='${type}' order by ${order}
select ${col},count(*) c from aoa_user group by ${col} having ${having}
